attBesluta.text: Strong enough to hold a top loader with net weight 60kg
super easy to setup and my garage freezer was slightly smaller than the minimum size but I was able to cut the tubes down two inches to fit.

Bought this for a stand alone freezer in basement. Received this very quickly and it was very easy to put together. Knowing the size of the freezer footprint allowed me to set the size easily and lock in place so that delivery men could place freezer directly on this mobile base. Worked perfectly and highly recommend if you need ability to have appliance off of floor with flexibility of moving. Also like the ability to level the base!
Prodotto rispondente alle aspettative, pienamente soddisfatto dell’acquisto.

Je l'utilise pour mon piano de cuisson de 90 cm. C'est un Très bon produit qualitatif très pratique pour entretenir le mur arrière et le sol derrière un grand piano de cuisson, qui est habituellement presque impossible à déplacer seul!

I bought this rolling stand for my fridge-sized freezer. The stand is very high quality and it was a great purchase. If I could make one suggestion it would be to assign a letter to the two corresponding sides to make installation easier as two sides are longer than the other two.
Maand geleden aangekocht in dit tot mijn uiterste tevredenheid. Wegens beperkte ruimte was het nodig dat mijn diepvriezer kon verplaatst worden. Door het mobiel systeem werd het probleem opgelost.
La consegna è sta rapida,bravi. L'aspetto sembra robusto...mi riservo la quinta stella solo perché non ho ancora messo sopra la lavatrice con asciugatrice sovrapposta.

Solid, heavy-duty base that does exactly what it promises once it's together. The load capacity is no exaggeration; it feels genuinely overbuilt, and there's no flex or wobble under a full-size appliance. The wheels move a heavy unit easily and the locks hold firmly, which is the whole reason to buy one of these. The catch is assembly. I went in expecting a ten-minute job and it was surprisingly fiddly
Une livraison ultra rapide, commandée dimanche, reçue mardi! Emballage impeccable. Je suis très étonnée de la qualité très très costaud, et ravis de mon achat. Merci
Solidny mebel. Stabilny. Szybkie rozkładanie i składanie. Obowiązkowa pozycja jak sam strzyżesz swoje zwierzęta.
Perfect to groom my toy poodle on. Great height, strong & very sturdy. Strongly recommend 👌
Purchased to do ultrasounds on small dogs at home. Smaller than expected but that’s on me. Would really only work on small to medium dogs.
Parfaitement conforme à la description. Facile à monter, propre et suffisamment résistant pour l'usage

Support très pratique et bien conçu. Il permet de ranger les bobines de filament de façon propre et organisée tout en restant facile à déplacer grâce aux roulettes. Structure robuste, montage simple et excellent rapport qualité-prix. Très satisfait de mon achat.
